name: upload_artifact
description: Upload a remote cache artifact, provided as base64 content, stored under the given hash. Optional inputs record the artifact's size, generation time, CI environment, and source revision.

requestBody.description: Provide this binary value as a base64 string.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

xArtifactClientCi.description: The continuous integration or delivery environment where this artifact was generated.

xArtifactClientInteractive.description: 1 if the client is an interactive shell. Otherwise 0

xArtifactDirtyHash.description: A hash representing uncommitted changes in the working directory when this artifact was generated.

xArtifactDuration.description: The time taken to generate the uploaded artifact in milliseconds.

xArtifactSha.description: The SHA of the source control revision that generated this artifact.

xArtifactTag.description: The base64 encoded tag for this artifact. The value is sent back to clients when the artifact is downloaded as the header `x-artifact-tag`
